main_text.p: animo cupio, & amplexari? Quam autem veritatem profi- teamur, omnium interest scire; eòque magis, quòd Edmundus Campianus, Jesuiticæ familiæ alumnus primarius, mihi jam obstrepere videatur, in Præfa- tione illa sua ad utramque Aca- demiam data: in qua Ecclesiæ Anglicanæ Doctores omnes, in- credibili jactantiâ, ad certamen Theologicum lacessivit, in hæc verba , {*}Campian. in Præfat. lib. de de- sem ratio- nibus.Equidem occîdi possum, superari non possum. Iis[?] enim Do- ctoribus infisto, quos ille Spiritus e- rudiit, qui nec fallitur, nec vinci- tur. Hoe ille [illegible, ~7 letters] ebuccinavit ante victoriam, ipse falsus vates, qui non itâ multò post in turri Londi-

page.notes: Show-through and faint text below the last line ("omnus", "p") are left out. The word after "ille" is overprinted by a mark and cannot be read. "Iis" is uncertain; the first letter could also be a J or a U-type form. The asterisk in the text and the note are the same reference mark. No page number is printed on this page.
